task: Calculate 3 raised to the power of 4 using the pow function; store the result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned rlm-set requires the result as the second argument, not the first.

nodes.code: (let ((pow (lambda (a b) (expt a b))))~~NL~~  (set! answer (apply pow 3 4))~~NL~~  (set! Final t)~~NL~~  (final true))
